title: OP Auto Farm | Tower | Dungeon | Boss Rush | Boss Farm Fast
features:
Free Features
- Auto Quest (with auto-select by level)
- Mob Farm (select specific mob or all)
- Boss Farm (select bosses, boss priority, TP to boss, boss scanner)
- Auto Use Abilities (slot selection, passive mode, fruit powers)
- Auto Haki
- Auto Join/Replay/Kill Dungeon
- Auto Join/Replay/Kill Boss Rush
- Auto Join/Replay/Kill Tower (with auto restart at floor)
- Auto Stats Allocation
- Auto Open Chests
- Island Teleport
- Race Reroll
- Clan Reroll
- Player Stats Viewer
- Weapon Selection
- Combat Tuning (hover height, farm below, hit speed)
- TP Bypass (dash spam)
- Anti-AFK
- Performance Settings (disable VFX, cutscenes, textures, shadows)
- Code Redemption
- Dungeon/Tower/Boss Rush Tracker UI
- Timed Boss Status (live tracking)
- Config Saving

New:
-- Auto Summon Boss
-- Revamped Auto Roll
-- New Bosses
-- Auto Boss Pity

Premium Only Features
- Player Farm (target and kill other players)
- Auto TP to Island When All Selected Bosses Are Defeated (idle at chosen island while waiting for respawns)
-- Auto Summon PITY Boss
